name: job-search-copilot
description: Codex plugin workspace for a privacy-conscious job search copilot.
author: Jiaqi Xiong <https://github.com/kikixiong>

scripts.build: npm run validate:config && tsc -b --pretty false && npm run build:client -w @kikixiong/job-search-copilot-viewer
scripts.test: npm run validate:config && tsx --test packages/*/test/**/*.test.ts packages/*/test/**/*.test.tsx
scripts.test:mcp: tsc -b packages/core packages/viewer --pretty false && tsx --test packages/mcp/test/**/*.test.ts
scripts.test:viewer: tsc -b packages/core packages/viewer --pretty false && npm test -w @kikixiong/job-search-copilot-viewer
